notes: 1900 Victorian two-flat, E side of Hyde mid-block Bergen Alley to North Point. Raised basement behind a tan planter wall (ground band), two main storeys of pale grey-white painted wood (lit d9dbd8), one cant bay with three sashes a storey left of centre, hooded window heads, a moulded cornice and a steep grey-blue front gable (roof block with a pitched cap). The long stoop and arched porch at the right have no key: a dark door under the stoop line at the right and an arched head over the right-hand upper sash stand in. The raised basement is furnished as a bare store (ground vacant). The model already has the bay at the left and the entry at the right. Applied: pale wall e6e7e4, a pale stucco planter/retaining base d9d6c8, the grilled street window removed, a straight stoop of 13 steps rising to the storey-1 entry on the right covering the street door (plaques), a lattice panel over the arched entry, a grey-blue shingle gable (roof block tinted 8e9aab, steeper cap) over a heavy grey-blue frieze band. A true gable pediment, the arched portico and the curved corner window have no key. The grey-blue top frieze sat behind the cornice's own frieze (trim-coloured, no tint key), so the grey-blue band moves to the storey-1/2 line; the pitched cap stays a hip (no gable key) and is foreshortened from the street. Body is grey-blue, not pale white (shaded wall samples 64707b, gable 708296) -> wall and bay a9b2bf with white trim, frieze band deepened to 7f8b9c. Bay-left/entry-right is already the game hand. Not applied (no keys): true front gable pediment, projecting open stair with cheek walls, curved corner bay, arched porch with lattice spandrels. Rework: body now cream e4e1d8 (was grey), grey-blue 8793a3 frieze bands between storeys, italianate cornice and the storey-1 arch hood removed (neither), taller narrower front-facing gable (roofBlock bw<depth gives a triangle end). Stair of ~15 risers, porch turned posts, balcony balustrade: no key. Cream retaining base e3dcc6, body e7e6e2, gable/frieze accents 8f98a6, arched head over the porch door and the storey-2 bay window. Skipped: 20-riser wide stair, ivy planter, spindle screen (no key); gable already the front roof block. Applied: the fan-crested window over the stair becomes a floor-to-head arched porch opening (storeyWindowSpans storey 1 + upperWindowArch round with white surround), bay rebuilt as hyB cant with a wide curtained front sash and narrow cant sashes, white cheek-wall plaques either side of the stair. Skipped: 18-20 riser stair (storey heights allow ~13), ivy planter and turned columns (no key). Rework bay-northpoint rd2: hip/gable roofBlock and wallTopM removed, flat roof behind a bracketed Italianate cornice (hbFrieze + hbCorniceBrackets + dentils), bay hood deeper with dentils and console brackets. Skipped: projecting exposed stair (builder stair is recessed, no key), turned posts/lattice screen, garden wall planting, hoods on small windows (windowHoods already on). Tint lift (2026-10-02): wall tints lifted toward the sunlit paint (t' = 1-(1-t)k). GroundBand lift (2026-10-03): groundBand tint #e3dcc6 -> #f1eee2 (same rule as walls; it was missed by the first colour pass).
